card.name: Section numbers in cross-references
card.fires_on: Digits and the space before digits inside bracketed section cross-references like [see Dosage and Administration (2.3, 2.4)], and the digit after Grade. Also fires weakly on scattered starts of drug names and words.

modes.label: Section cross-reference numbers
modes.description: The number or gap in a section reference to another part of the label.

modes.label: Grade numbers
modes.description: The space before the severity grade number after the word Grade.

modes.label: Scattered word starts
modes.description: Partway through drug names or other words, with no shared theme.
modes.example: permanent discontinuation of<< Y>>ERVOY with nivolumab

card.writes: It promotes odd word pieces like bul and bullet and suppresses experiment words, which suggests no useful output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the numbers in label section references and grade levels, and sometimes in the middle of drug names.
